commentaire: The actual leader after stage 10 and number 4 today, Lizandro Roberto AJCU, and today's stage winner, Federico MUNOZ FERNANDEZ, both tested positive for EPO after stage 7. Therefore they were disqualified from stage 7 and all further stages of the Vuelta a Guatemala. Carlos LOPEZ, tested positive for EPO after stage 9 and was disqualified from stage 9 and all further stages of the Vuelta a Guatemala. Today's number 4, Noel Armando VASQUEZ MENDOZA, tested positive for EPO after today's stage 10, and was disqualified from stage 10 and all further stages of the Vuelta a Guatemala.
titre: Vuelta a Guatemala, Stage 10 : Huehuetenango - Sololá (139 km)
